sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface expression confirmed by flow cytometry (non-permeabilized anti-HA staining, L7); ADP-stimulated receptor internalization preserved and measurable by ELISA (L5); ligand binding confirmed in fixed platelets (L2). Function intact.
sites.rationale: L1 explicitly states 'N-terminal HA-epitope tagged P2Y12' in a full-length, membrane-anchored context. P2RY12 has no signal peptide; the N-terminus (residues 1–27) is extracellular per the topology landmarks, and the C-terminus (302–342) is intracellular — exactly one extracellular terminus exists, so the N-terminal tag prepends before M1 (insert_after_residue=0, residue_after='M'). The 27-residue extracellular N-terminal span provides ample room (>>3 residues from TM1 boundary at residue 28) for a ~15–23 aa ALFA-type tag. Multiple independent clips (L1–L7) confirm surface display and preserved ADP-stimulated function. 1321N1 human astrocytoma cells stably expressing N-terminal HA-epitope tagged P2Y12 (full-length, membrane-anchored) were used in internalization studies confirming surface expression. Separately, HEK293 cells expressing HA-tagged P2Y12 were surface-stained by anti-HA antibody under non-permeabilized conditions (flow cytometry, L7), and ADP-stimulated internalization of the HA-tagged receptor was measured by ELISA (L5).

sources.claim: In these studies we used 1321N1 human astrocytoma cells stably expressing N-terminal HA-epitope tagged versions of either receptor.

literature_notes: L8 and L9 describe DYKDDDK (FLAG)-tagged P2RY12 constructs but do not state whether the FLAG tag is at the N- or C-terminus, and the only readout is western blot (total expression of mutant vs. wild-type). Because the tag position is ambiguous (N-terminal extracellular vs. C-terminal intracellular) and no surface expression is demonstrated for the FLAG-tagged construct, these clips do not qualify for a surface tag site under the topology_derived rule, which requires that the tag be implied to reside on the extracellular face. The HA-tag site (L1–L7) is the sole ledger-supported extracellular tag site. ECL1 (83–98), ECL2 (164–188), and ECL3 (260–279) are extracellular loops that could in principle carry an internal tag, but no ledger line reports a tolerated insertion in any of these loops for P2RY12 or a close ortholog, so no internal sites are proposed.
